identity.name: Royal Oak Selfwinding 37
identity.one_liner: The 37mm Royal Oak — the mid-size that quietly became the best-proportioned modern reference.

narrative.story: Launched alongside the 15400 in 2012, the 15450ST sat between the Jumbo's 39mm and nothing — a 37mm case that many collectors argue wears closest to the 1972 original's intent. Produced to about 2021 as the mid-size alternative, it was long overlooked, then rediscovered as tastes moved back toward smaller cases. Silver and blue dials, caliber 3120.
narrative.collector_notes: Marketed for years as a unisex/smaller option, so many examples come from lighter wear — good hunting for sharp cases. The 37mm slot was later refilled by the 15550 at 38mm, which keeps demand for this footprint alive.
